# AstroGate Protocol (`llms.txt`)
> Decentralized Fair-Flywheel Token Launchpad, Soroswap AMM Interface, Sorobits SEP-50 NFTs & Telegram Mini App on Stellar / Soroban.

AstroGate operates with zero custodial backend: client-encrypted native wallet signatures (`PBKDF2-SHA256` + `AES-GCM-256` vault, optional `BiometricManager` / WebAuthn PRF quick-unlock, linked to Telegram `@username` via Ed25519 proofs with `AGVAULT1:` cross-device sync and exportable `S...` seeds) authorize all writes directly against Stellar Soroban RPC & Horizon.

## Fair-Flywheel v4.5 Tokenomics
- Standard Supply: `10,000,000` tokens (`7` decimals, `1 XLM = 10,000,000` stroops), hard-capped via OpenZeppelin `Capped`, ownership renounced atomically on launch.
- Creation Fee: `7 XLM` fixed protocol fee + `>= 2 XLM` initial creator curve buy (locked until graduation, 7-day stalled rescue, or 30-day closed principal return).
- Allocation:
  - `66.0%` (`6,600,000`) Virtual Bonding Curve (`1,000 vXLM -> 1,000 real XLM` graduation target, `4.00x` curve range; softened 3-stage buy fees `0.30% -> 0.50% -> 0.25%`, sell fees `1.20% -> 1.80% -> 1.50%`). P2P transfers locked until graduation.
  - `33.0%` (`3,300,000`) Soroswap DEX Pool Reserve + `>= 1,000 XLM` at graduation (`0%` price cliff), with `100%` of LP tokens time-locked inside the Launchpad contract for `7 years` (`reclaim_expired_lp` thereafter).
  - `0.3%` (`30,000`) 15-day post-graduation creator vesting (`5 × 6,000` every 3 days).
  - `0.40%` (`40,000`) 3-Checkpoint Jackpot Ladder (`+5,000` Spark at `250 XLM` and `+10,000` King Crown at `500 XLM` escrowed in-contract until graduation via `claim_jackpot`; `+25,000` Graduation Jackpot awarded at `1,000 XLM`).
  - `0.30%` (`30,000`) Developer / Protocol Ecosystem allocation transferred to treasury upon graduation.
- Organic Deflation (zero idle burn vault): `60%` of surplus curve floor fees dedicated to anti-MEV chunked DEX Buyback & Burn (`trigger_buyback_burn` / `trigger_buyback_burn_with_bounty`, capped at `min(0.25% pool, 0.8000000 XLM)` per call with `2%` keeper XLM rebate) + 3-tier Burn-to-Chat (`>= 50` Chat / `>= 500` Hype / `>= 5,000` King via `burn_shout`).
- Governance & Sorobits Safety: 48-hour upgrade timelock (`propose_upgrade`/`execute_upgrade`/`cancel_upgrade`) on Launchpad and Sorobits; two-ledger commit-reveal RNG (`commit_capsule`/`reveal_capsule`, `commit_forge`/`reveal_forge`) and `TokenBaseXp` on Sorobits.

## Repository & Machine Specs
- GitHub Repository: `https://github.com/NunaLabsDev/astrogate`
- Full LLM & Auditor Context: `/llms-full.txt`
- OpenAPI 3.1 Spec: `/openapi.json`
- Remote MCP Endpoint: `POST /mcp` (local stdio: `cd frontend && npm run mcp`)
- AI Coding Agent Onboarding: `/AGENTS.md` (and `/CLAUDE.md`)
- Architecture overview: `/ARCHITECTURE.md`
- Security audit guide & invariants: `/AUDIT_GUIDE.md`
- Trust model & security policy: `/SECURITY.md`
- Trademark & anti-phishing policy: `/TRADEMARK.md`
- Contracts (Rust / Soroban):
  - `/contracts/launchpad/src/contract.rs` (Bonding Curve, Graduation, Anti-MEV Buyback, Vesting, Burn-to-Chat, Admin Governance)
  - `/contracts/token/src/contract.rs` (SEP-41 Capped Burnable Token + Curve Transfer Lock + TTL extension)
  - `/contracts/sorobits/src/contract.rs` & `/contracts/sorobits/src/engine.rs` (SEP-50 RLE Pixel Art + 256-bit Genomes)
- Frontend & Crypto Vault:
  - `/frontend/src/lib/network.ts` (`NETWORK_PRESETS`, multi-RPC failover)
  - `/frontend/src/lib/hot-wallet/` & `/frontend/src/lib/wallet-directory.ts` (PBKDF2-SHA256 210k + AES-GCM-256 with publicKey AAD, Primary `@username` Ed25519 link, `AGVAULT1:` sync, RAM zeroing)
  - `/frontend/src/lib/tokenomics.ts`, `/frontend/src/lib/token.ts`, `/frontend/src/lib/soroswap.ts`
- Cloudflare Pages Functions & Worker (`https://astrogate.pages.dev`):
  - `/frontend/functions/` (Service Binding `ASTROW` -> `astrogate-stellar` Worker for `/telegram/webhook`, `/api/*`, `/mcp`, `/openapi.json`, `/health`)
  - `/frontend/worker/index.ts`, `/frontend/worker/api.ts`, `/frontend/worker/mcp.ts`, `/frontend/worker/events.ts`, `/frontend/worker/rpc.ts`, `/frontend/worker/quests.ts`, `/frontend/worker/wallet.ts`, `/frontend/worker/telegram-auth.ts`, `/frontend/worker/ai.ts`
  - Telegram-Only Mini App gate (`POST /api/telegram/session`, `24h` HMAC `initData` TTL; external browsers see `TelegramLandingGate` redirecting to `@AstroGateSorobanBot`). Automated broadcasts route exclusively to `@AstroGateFeed` (community chat stays command-only and spam-free).

## SDK Integration (`frontend/src/sdk/index.ts`)
Read-only and quoting functions for autonomous agents:
- `getMarketTokens({ maxTokens })`
- `getTokenDetails(tokenId)`
- `quoteSwap({ tokenId, amountIn, direction, slippagePercent })`
- `verifyAntiRug(tokenId)`
- `fetchTokenEvents(tokenId, { maxEvents })`
- `checkRpcHealth()`
